sources.title: OpenStreetMap footprint way/23668101
sources.note: ODbL. Existing building footprint on the west corner of Elias Angeles and Paz streets, facing the cathedral grounds, retained unchanged. Edit dates are not construction dates; no construction year is assigned. Generated subdivision: Santa Cruz.

sources.title: Naga City Ordinance No. 2003-003, Section 6
sources.note: Enacted January 15, 2003. Lists the Abella home stone structure at the corner of Elias Angeles and Paz streets.

sources.title: Google Street View
sources.note: October 2024 panorama inspected October 8, 2026. The west corner holds an old two-storey row with a masonry ground floor and a timber upper floor. A tenant's sign gives its main office as "Abella Bldg." in front of the cathedral, naming the building. The other corners are the cathedral and seminary grounds and a modern block. Capture dates are not construction dates. No image is saved or distributed.

sources.title: Google Maps satellite
sources.note: Public satellite reference inspected October 8, 2026 with the frozen OSM outlines. The corner row's roofs occupy way/23668101. Imagery date is unknown; no age is inferred and no bitmap ships.
